source_documents.title: Spectrophotometric Studies of a Fluorescent Naphthalenediimide PET and ICT pH Indicator and DNA Intercalator

reference_evidence_units.quote: The four proton receptors are capable, when unprotonated, of PET from an amine to the excited NDI fluorophore, which results in a decreased fluorescence output.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Unprotonated amines quench the NDI by PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The effective switching fluorescent enhancement of compound 3 is 190-fold
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 3

reference_evidence_units.quote: Unlike compound 2, compound 3 exhibits both PET and ICT mechanisms.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 3

reference_evidence_units.quote: The ICT mechanism causes a change in the absorbance observed as a bathochromic shift in the UV-vis spectrum on going from acidic to basic pHs.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 3
reference_evidence_units.statement: ICT shows in the absorption shift.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Assuming a coulombic term contributes 0.10 V (versus SCE), the driving for PET within compound 2 is −1.1 eV.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 2
reference_evidence_units.statement: PET is strongly exergonic in compound 2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, a more competitive deactivation pathway in core-unsubstituted NDIs is rapid intersystem crossing (ISC) from the S1 excited
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fast S1-to-upper-triplet ISC keeps compound 2 nearly dark (QY < 0.001) at any pH.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Cites the literature; ISC is not measured here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Compound 2 is a one-input H+ -driven YES logic gate by design but functions as a PASS 0 logic gate.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 2

reference_evidence_units.quote: Compound 1 is a fluorescent PASS 1 logic gate devoid of tertiary amine receptors.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1

reference_evidence_units.quote: Indeed, it gives a strong fluorescence independent of any external input (Figure 5). The fluorescence quantum yield (ΦF ) is 32% in 1:1 (v/v) methanol/water.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1

contrast_group.varied_factor: NDI receptor design: core substitution (none vs two amino groups) and tertiary-amine receptors (present vs absent)
contrast_group.paper_difference: The core-unsubstituted bis(dimethylaminoethyl) NDI stays dark at every pH (fast ISC); core amination with four dimethylaminoethyl receptors gives a 190-fold PET off-on switch; the core-diamino control without tertiary amines is bright (QY 32%) at every pH.
